profile.headline: Software Engineer at Wealthfront
profile.summary: I am a seasoned full stack developer with over 5 years of experience, specializing in technologies ranging from Java and Spring to TypeScript and React Native. My professional journey has been deeply rooted in the finance sector, where I've honed my skills as a problem solver and an architect of robust, scalable solutions. I thrive on the challenges of designing and implementing innovative software solutions that meet the complex needs of the finance industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	DRI for various projects, overseeing and working on development life cycle from technical specs through A/B testing to completion for React Native mobile app
•	Lead for new financial data source UX integration, primarily building out new flows on the app for new and existing connections to financial sources. Helping expand the range of banks supported through the app
•	Contributed to rebranding of the app for improved user experience, which included creating and rebuilding screens along with converting JSX components to Typescript. As well as updating backend services.
•	Led sunsetting of old SMS chatbot which was being used by over 35k monthly users
•	Worked on updating Long-term Savings products, investment and retirement, to increase retention and adoption of products.
•	Architected updates to Low Balance Protection product allowing users to choose different funding sources to help prevent overdrafts
•	Part of on-call rotation, fixed user bugs and commanded larger scale issues. Also created migration jobs for broad data corrections
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · React Native · ReactJS · MongoDB · Continuous Integration (CI)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Java · Continuous Integration (CI) · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Spring MVC · Gradle · Oracle Database · Couchbase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed with Spring Boot and Java 8+ implementing reactive programming to create almost real time cruise pricing
•	Utilized Project Reactor to create fast, asynchronous and non-blocking API
•	Increased NoSQL database proficiency by operating on Couchbase buckets
•	Exposed to technologies such as Grafana, Jenkins, Kibana, Elasticsearch, Kafka
•	Worked in a completely microservice architecture

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
•	Contribute to the development of monitoring and automation tools used in the management of our infrastructure using Java 8 and Spring Boot
•       Breakdown and investigate root cause for reporting and further troubleshooting for identifying bugs and errors
•	Provided system support and resolved any IT related issues

positions.title: Software and Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Utilized ReactJS to update and create features for the Slay Web Application
•	Worked extensively contributing to components in ReactJS
•	Worked with ES6 in ReactJS
•	Furthered experience with MongoDB and Node.js, also integrated third party API’s (OneSignal, Auth0, Stripe)
•	Used React Native to create mobile application for Slay
•	Created and integrated API’s with React Native for the mobile application
•	Created all the views in React Native for the mobile application

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked with the MEAN stack to create new designs for the website
•	Gained experience working with Angular and MongoDB
•	Developed my skills in UI development

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description: Taught physics to upcoming 8 graders who come from a variety of local Miami public schools.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered from my Sophomore year to the end of my Junior year at Breakthrough Miami. Helped teach electives and had various roles in the camp.

projects.title: Online Survey Website
projects.description:
•	Used Spring Framework and Java to create a web application, that allows users to create surveys, view survey results, delete surveys, and allow survey respondents to submit surveys.
•	Worked with JSP to create multiple pages and worked with Spring Boot authentication and user login with registration.
•	Implemented Spring mail to send emails to survey respondents
•	Integrated SQL database with the Spring Framework
•	Furthered experience in MVC frameworks and created all the API calls from the JSP pages to the Spring controllers and services

projects.title: Fitness Calendar Website
projects.description: Worked using the LAMP stack to create a fitness web application that allows users to add popular workouts from various muscle groups into a weekly calendar. Users could also specify the amount of sets and reps for their workouts. The website featured a workout directory where users could click on a workout to open an informational section that showed a video tutorial and a description of the workout.
